## What changed

## Provider or contract changes

If applicable, include a redacted saved response fixture and explain changes to
sources, dates, cache behavior, exit codes or JSON fields. Keep tests offline.
Mark synthetic examples clearly and preserve the accuracy and terms caveats.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within its stated scope.
- [ ] Documentation matches the behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs or runtime files are included.
- [ ] Provider data is attributed and blocks are not retried.
